description: Given an element and a claimed metal/nonmetal/metalloid classification, judge plausible/implausible. A vocabulary check passes any value in {metal, nonmetal, metalloid}; only world knowledge catches a planted defect (oxygen labelled 'metal'). Second domain alongside labels_plausibility, to test generalization, not just phase recall. Reuses the shipped build_label_prompt + LabelVerdict; passes NO answer-bearing context.
